```{=html}
<link href="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@4.1.2/dist/maplibre-gl.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@4.1.2/dist/maplibre-gl.js"></script>

<div id="drought-map" style="width:100%; height:750px; border-radius:8px;"></div>

<script>
async function init_map() {

  const [basin, drought, reservoirs, rivers] = await Promise.all([
    fetch("/GIS_Data/CR_Basin_Merge_HUC2.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("/GIS_Data/Current_Drought.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("/GIS_Data/Reservoirs.geojson").then(r => r.json()),
    fetch("/GIS_Data/HydroSheds_Rivers.geojson").then(r => r.json())
  ])

  const map = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: "drought-map",
    style:     "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark",
    center:    [-112, 36.5],
    zoom:      5
  })

  map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right")
  map.addControl(new maplibregl.ScaleControl(), "bottom-left")

  map.on("load", () => {

    // ── Drought ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("drought", { type: "geojson", data: drought })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "drought-fill",
      type:   "fill",
      source: "drought",
      paint: {
        "fill-color": [
          "step", ["get", "DM"],
          "#FFFF00",
          0, "#FFFF00",
          1, "#FCD37F",
          2, "#FFAA00",
          3, "#E60000",
          4, "#730000"
        ],
        "fill-opacity": 0.7
      }
    })

    // ── Basin ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("basin", { type: "geojson", data: basin })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "basin-outline",
      type:   "line",
      source: "basin",
      paint:  { "line-color": "#d1d0d0", "line-width": 2 }
    })

    // ── Rivers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("rivers", {
      type: "geojson",
      data: rivers,
      attribution: '<a href="https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrorivers" target="_blank">HydroSheds</a>'
    })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "rivers-line",
      type:   "line",
      source: "rivers",
      layout: { "line-join": "round", "line-cap": "round" },
      paint: {
        "line-color": [
          "interpolate", ["linear"], ["get", "DIS_AV_CMS"],
          0,   "#7bbbf7",
          550, "#054aa5"
        ],
        "line-width": [
          "interpolate", ["linear"], ["get", "DIS_AV_CMS"],
          1,   1,
          550, 12
        ],
        "line-opacity": 0.85
      }
    })

    // ── Reservoirs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    map.addSource("reservoirs", {
      type: "geojson",
      data: reservoirs,
      attribution: '<a href="https://data.usbr.gov/catalog" target="_blank">USBR</a>'
    })
    map.addLayer({
      id:     "reservoirs-circle",
      type:   "circle",
      source: "reservoirs",
      paint: {
        "circle-color":        "#1088eb",
        "circle-radius":       3,
        "circle-stroke-color": "white",
        "circle-stroke-width": 1,
        "circle-opacity":      0.9
      }
    })

  })
}

init_map()
</script>
```

::: chart-description
<font size="2">Data from the National Drought Mitigation Center (NDMC), the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).  
  
[US Drought Monitor GIS Data](https://droughtmonitor.unl.edu/DmData/GISData.aspx)</font>
:::
